title: New promo video and game update after gathering feedback on reddit
author: happypird
selftext:
I tried to cut off some different art style asset and use the character art which isn't made by AI that I already have.  
And I recreate the Tilt maze game with the same style that the Core Base had.

Posting it just for letting those who gave constructive suggestions to me know that I'm serious about making this game Better.

I'm glad to talk about how I do before & after since this post if you ask.  
(https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/s/EyJ52KarYK)

Here's the free Demo Link:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5142470/Genius\_Simulator](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5142470/Genius_Simulator)  
AI disclosure: There's two texture pack that player can choose: Meme assets are made by human. HD texture Pack were AI-generated and reviewed by a human.
